DISCLAIMER: This document is a draft prepared for informational purposes only and does not constitute formal legal advice. It should be reviewed, finalized, and executed under the guidance of a qualified legal professional in accordance with applicable local laws. *** # RENTAL AGREEMENT This RENTAL AGREEMENT is made and entered into on this _____ day of _______________, 20___, at Chennai, Tamil Nadu. ### BETWEEN **Mr. John Doe**, residing at [Insert Landlord's Address], hereinafter referred to as the **"LANDLORD"** (which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context or meaning thereof, mean and include his heirs, executors, administrators, legal representatives, and assigns) of the **FIRST PART**; ### AND **Ms. Jane Doe**, residing at [Insert Tenant's Address], hereinafter referred to as the **"TENANT"** (which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context or meaning thereof, mean and include her heirs, executors, administrators, legal representatives, and assigns) of the **SECOND PART**. The Landlord and the Tenant are hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Parties" and individually as the "Party". WHEREAS the Landlord is the sole and absolute owner of the residential premises situated at [Insert Complete Address/Description of Rented Property] (hereinafter referred to as the **"Scheduled Premises"**); AND WHEREAS the Tenant has approached the Landlord to take the Scheduled Premises on rent for residential purposes, and the Landlord has agreed to lease out the same on the terms and conditions set forth herein: --- ### NOW, THEREFORE, THIS AGREEMENT WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS: #### 1. Term of Tenancy The tenancy shall be for a fixed period of 12 (twelve) months commencing from **1 October 2026** and expiring on **30 September 2027**, unless terminated earlier in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement. Any renewal shall be subject to the mutual written consent of both Parties on mutually agreed terms. #### 2. Monthly Rent and Payment Terms 2.1. The Tenant shall pay to the Landlord a monthly rent of **₹15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only)**. 2.2. The rent shall be payable in advance on or before the [Insert Date, e.g., 5th] day of each English calendar month. 2.3. The rent shall be paid via [Insert Mode of Payment, e.g., Bank Transfer / Cheque / UPI] into the bank account designated by the Landlord: - Bank Name: [Insert Bank Name] - Account Holder Name: John Doe - Account Number: [Insert Account Number] - IFSC Code: [Insert IFSC Code] #### 3. Security Deposit 3.1. The Tenant has paid to the Landlord a sum of **₹30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only)** as an interest-free refundable security deposit. 3.2. The receipt of this deposit is hereby acknowledged by the Landlord. 3.3. The security deposit shall be refunded to the Tenant upon the expiration or early termination of this Agreement, after deducting any unpaid rent, utility bills, or costs required to repair any damages to the Scheduled Premises caused by the Tenant (reasonable wear and tear excepted), against peaceful delivery of vacant possession of the premises. #### 4. Utilities and Outgoings 4.1. The Tenant shall directly pay the electricity charges, water charges, and any other utility charges consumed during the period of the tenancy as per actual meter readings and bills issued by the competent authorities. 4.2. Regular building maintenance charges (if applicable) shall be paid by the [Insert "Tenant" or "Landlord"]. #### 5. Use of Premises 5.1. The Scheduled Premises shall be used solely and exclusively for residential purposes by the Tenant and her immediate family members. 5.2. The Tenant shall not use the premises for any commercial, illegal, or offensive purposes. 5.3. The Tenant shall not sublet, assign, or transfer possession of the Scheduled Premises, either in whole or in part, to any third party. #### 6. Maintenance and Repairs 6.1. The Tenant shall maintain the interior of the Scheduled Premises in a clean, hygienic, and tenantable condition. 6.2. The Tenant shall be responsible for minor day-to-day repairs (e.g., replacement of bulbs, fuses, tap washers). Major structural repairs shall be the responsibility of the Landlord, unless necessitated by negligence or misuse on the part of the Tenant. 6.3. The Tenant shall not carry out any structural additions or alterations to the Scheduled Premises without obtaining prior written consent from the Landlord. #### 7. Landlord's Right of Inspection The Landlord or his authorized representative shall be entitled to enter and inspect the Scheduled Premises at reasonable hours during the daytime, subject to giving at least [Insert Notice Period, e.g., 24 hours] advance verbal or written notice to the Tenant. #### 8. Termination Clause 8.1. **Termination for Convenience:** Either Party may terminate this Agreement prior to the expiry of the term by giving [Insert Notice Period, e.g., 1 (one) month] prior written notice to the other Party, or rent in lieu thereof. 8.2. **Termination for Breach:** In the event of default in payment of rent for a continuous period of [Insert Period, e.g., 2 consecutive months], or any breach of the covenants contained in this Agreement, the Landlord shall be entitled to terminate this Agreement forthwith by issuing a written notice of [Insert Cure Period, e.g., 15 days] to rectify the breach. If the breach is not rectified within the notice period, the tenancy shall stand terminated. 8.3. **Vacating Premises:** Upon termination or expiry of this Agreement, the Tenant shall peacefully vacate and hand over vacant, physical possession of the Scheduled Premises along with all fixtures and fittings in good working condition (ordinary wear and tear excepted). #### 9. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any disputes arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in **Chennai, Tamil Nadu**. --- ### SCHEDULE OF PROPERTY All that piece and parcel of the residential premises situated at: [Insert Detailed Property Address, Floor, Door Number, Survey Number, etc.] Consisting of: [Insert Room Configuration, e.g., Living Room, Bedroom(s), Kitchen, Bathrooms] Fixtures and Fittings: [Insert Fixtures, e.g., Fans, Lights, Geysers, if applicable] --- IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Landlord and the Tenant have set their hands and signed this Rental Agreement on the day, month, and year first written above.
________________________________________ **JOHN DOE** (Landlord)
________________________________________ **JANE DOE** (Tenant) --- ### WITNESSES: 1. **Witness 1:** Signature: ___________________________ Name: [Insert Witness 1 Name] Address: [Insert Witness 1 Address]
2. **Witness 2:** Signature: ___________________________ Name: [Insert Witness 2 Name] Address: [Insert Witness 2 Address]
